sections.title: The letter name
paragraphs: The letter name is (тэ) /tɛ/. Its main sound is heard in the word (стол) /stol/, which means table. This letter has three sounds.

sections.title: Mouth movements
paragraphs: For the first sound, press the tip of your tongue against the upper teeth. Release the air without breath. For the second sound, make the consonant palatalized. Palatalized means a consonant said with the middle of the tongue raised toward the roof of the mouth. For the third sound, touch your throat to feel it shake. That means the consonant is voiced.

sections.title: Reading the variants
paragraphs: The letter makes its hard sound before hard vowels, most consonants, and at the end of words, as in (стол) /stol/. It makes its soft sound before soft vowels and the soft sign, as in (тётя) /ˈtʲɵ.tʲə/. A sound change called assimilation happens before voiced consonants, making the letter voiced as in (отдых) /ˈod.dɨx/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not puff air when you say this letter, as in top. Put your finger before your lips and feel no burst of air. Do not say the soft sound like the ch in chair. Keep the tongue tip flat against the upper teeth instead.
